# `ExtraInfo` Class

<p>Internal implementation detail class that provides out-of-line storage for extra info used by the machine instruction when this info cannot be stored in-line within the instruction itself. <a href="#details">More...</a></p>

## Description {#details}

<p>Internal implementation detail class that provides out-of-line storage for extra info used by the machine instruction when this info cannot be stored in-line within the instruction itself.</p>


<p>This has to be defined eagerly due to the implementation constraints of <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/pointersumtype">PointerSumType</a></span> where it is used.</p>


<p>Definition at line 160 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/codegen/machineinstr-h">MachineInstr.h</a>.</p>
